description: spec/matching.md section 17: the form of the three result fields after the fifteen of v5 (SECURELOCK-HARDENING-SPEC.md 13.4), field 15 landedAt, field 16 ranUntil and field 17 slClass, as the trustedzones write them and PoxMatching, the validators' members and the runners read them. A result that carries them is version v6 (field 0 `v6`); a v5 result carries the fifteen fields and no more. PoxMatching's decoder does not read field 0. Each field is the whole of its bytes between its colons, written as plain unsigned decimal: "0", or a digit 1 to 9 followed by digits 0 to 9, with no prefix or label, sign, space or leading zero; landedAt and ranUntil at most 2^64 - 1, slClass 0 (the custom class) or 1 (the default class). A result whose three fields are not all in that form, or that has fewer than eighteen fields, carries none of them: it has no class, and noteAmbiguous refuses it (NotAmbiguous reason 4). The eighteenth colon ends field 17; what follows it is not read. accepted: results whose three fields are read, with the values decoded; refused: results whose fields are not read, with the first field that fails (null when fewer than eighteen fields) and its test, empty, leadingZero, notDigit or aboveMax in that order (absent for fewer than eighteen fields); each with the stored result a node adds.
base: result-v5.json examples.plain.result with field 0 replaced by the version (v6 when `after` holds a field, v5 when it holds none) and field 1 by the task code, then the fields of `after` each after a colon

versions.v5: the fifteen fields of result-v5.json and no more
versions.v6: the fifteen fields of v5 followed by landedAt, ranUntil and slClass, fields 15 to 17; fields after field 17 are not read

transaction.note: privateKey is keccak256 of keyLabel, `to` the last 20 bytes of keccak256 of toLabel; the stored result is v3:<the signed transaction, 0x hex>:<cid>, the transaction calling _addResultToOrder(orderId, result)
